Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.22.4
SASpro is now Instance Aware. Meaning if you right click a file and say open with setiastrosuitepro it will open the file in the currently running instance of saspro. You can also now launch dedicated new instances via command line --new-instance tag.

File Associations. During windows installation there is a checkbox for file associations. For all OS in the menu About->File Associations, allows you to select various files types to be associated with saspro.

Stacking Suite updates to prevent OOM in your ram when stacking thousands of files (PR merge contributor).
